title: Forecasting a tenure disappointment
hook: Two stated cases: explore the gap between predicted and recorded impact.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the gap between predicted and recorded impact affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Error, regardless of the stated inputs.
